about_short_description.short_description: Global Fertility is a fertility and reproductive genetics centre.

product.name: IVF and ICSI
product.description: In-vitro fertilization (IVF) and intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) are procedures that involve fertilizing an egg with sperm outside the body.

product.name: Reproductive Genetic Testing
product.description: Reproductive genetic testing involves sampling and testing embryos to learn about their genetic characteristics, including gender and possible mutations.

product.name: Egg Freezing
product.description: Egg freezing involves stimulating a woman's ovaries to produce several eggs, collecting them, freezing them, and storing them for future use.

product.name: Ovarian Rejuvenation
product.description: Ovarian rejuvenation through platelet-rich-plasma infusion is an experimental treatment aimed at improving fertility, egg quality, and quantity in women with diminished ovarian reserve.

product.name: Reproductive and Fertility-enhancing Surgeries
product.description: These surgeries address visible causes of infertility, such as endometriosis or uterine adhesions, to enhance fertility and increase the chances of conceiving.

product.name: Surgical Sperm Recovery
product.description: Surgical sperm recovery is a technique that allows surgeons to harvest sperm directly from the testicles when there is little to no sperm present in ejaculate.
